property_summary: For any clone instance where the owner address and collateral token address are different, calling collateral() on the reference contract returns the collateral token address (from immutable arg offset 0x14), but the mutant returns the owner address (from offset 0x0), violating the invariant that the returned address must match the collateral token provided during deployment.
change_summary: Replace address(_getArgAddress(0x14)) with address(_getArgAddress(0x0)) so collateral returns the owner address as ERC20.
